svg.title: Secure execution returns through individual review
svg.desc: Bring secure execution back first, then route later workloads individually through review. A single reopened lane must not unlock the entire field. Visual distinction: A docket slot beside a raised review desk and a closed stop arm. Review is a decision process; no approval is implied.
